While they squabble over peaking emissions and balancing carbon sinks, they conveniently ignore the toxic fallout from their spraying operations. The U.S. plays its political games of joining and withdrawing, but this is not mere politics—it’s about our survival! We must demand real #climateaction and #climatejustice by shining a light on #chemtrails and stopping the spraying that poisons our earth. It’s time to awaken and rise against this covert assault on our environment! #geoengineering #stopspraying

history.contentIn: Polar bears (Ursus maritimus) are not just adorable symbols; they are crucial indicators of the health of our planet, and their survival is directly tied to the melting sea ice. As the Arctic warms—twice the global average—the ice disappears, jeopardizing their hunting grounds. The false narrative that "polar bears are fine" due to stable subpopulations is a dangerous distraction from the truth: their existence is critically dependent on ice. With longer ice-free seasons, we're facing dire consequences, including increased fasting and lower cub survival rates. We must expose the lies that suggest polar bears are thriving while planes spray toxic chemicals in our skies. The real crisis is the loss of sea ice, worsened by pollution and misguided conservation strategies. It’s time to rise up for #climateaction and #climatejustice, demanding an immediate halt to the spraying that fuels our climate emergency. We must #stopspraying to safeguard our polar bears and their icy homes! #chemtrails #geoengineering.
